{{Short description|Piecewise-linear manifold}}
In [[mathematics]], specifically in [[differential topology]], a '''Kervaire manifold''' <math>K^{4n+2}</math> is a [[piecewise-linear manifold]] of [[dimension of a manifold|dimension]] <math>4n+2</math> constructed by {{harvs|txt|last=Kervaire|first=Michel|authorlink=Michel Kervaire|year=1960}} by plumbing together the [[tangent bundle]]s of two [[n-sphere|<math>(2n+1)</math>-spheres]], and then gluing a [[ball (mathematics)|ball]] to the result. In 10 dimensions this gives a piecewise-linear manifold with no [[smooth structure]].
